text:
marc: Heads-up: release candidate is blocked. CI failed during regen and changelog bot picked a minor bump because generated types changed.
regen-bot: buildkite: #6001 failed during `yarn regen` -> git diff check :x: diff attached
lisa: Minimal diff: 
```diff
- export interface StartOnboard { firstName: string; company?: string }
+ export interface StartOnboard { company?: string; firstName: string }
```
sam: This is the nondeterministic OpenAPI property ordering again. Our typegen preserves input property order unless `--stable` canonicalizes keys.
polly: changelog-bot: Detected changed files -> suggested bump: minor -> merge blocked by semver-guard
marc: Short-term fixes: 1) add generated globs to .semver-ignore (e.g. src/openapi/**.generated.ts, src/generated/**) 2) run `yarn typegen --stable` and commit regenerated files 3) set REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false in CI matrix to avoid interactive prompts during sample-app e2e
lisa: I'll add .semver-ignore and push a stable regen commit. Also adding a PR checklist item: "run `yarn typegen --stable`"
ci-bot: marc pushed a PR: fix/regen-stable -> running build :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #6002 rerun failed - sample-app e2e timed out waiting for onboarding prompt :x:
marc: Looks like not all CI jobs had the env var. Need to add REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false at workflow level or container env.
sam: We should also add a CI pre-merge check: `yarn typegen --stable --check` so PRs fail early if golden files weren't regenerated locally.
polly: Follow-ups: RFC to make deterministic typegen the default (flip `--stable` on), update changelog-bot to consult .semver-ignore before picking bumps, add a lightweight regen check to the repo PR template and CI, and ask infra to pin node/npm across runners to avoid prettier/tsc formatting churn.
lisa: Pushed global CI env var and .semver-ignore. Re-running build. :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #6002 rerun passed :white_check_mark: changelog-bot: consulted .semver-ignore -> no bump suggested
marc: Great. I'll merge once the release branch is green. Thanks all! :rocket:
